source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-39

procedures.title: Engine special tools (figure 21)
steps: Use figure 21 in the manual to identify the J-numbered tools called for in the engine procedures.
notes: J-4536 engine lift kit; J-1264, J-8058, J-5853 torque wrenches (0-200 ft. lb., 0-50 ft. lb., 0-100 in. lb.).
J-8087 cylinder bore indicator set; J-8001 universal indicator set; J-7316 belt tension gauge; J-8037 piston ring compressor.
J-6994 and J-9510 piston pin assembly tools; J-5239 and J-6305 connecting rod guide sets (3/8", 11/32").
J-8062 valve spring compressor; J-8101 valve guide cleaner; J-5830 and J-7049 valve guide reamers (11/32", 3/8"); J-8089 carbon removing brush.
J-5860 cylinder head bolt wrench; J-5715 and J-6036 rocker arm stud reamers (.003", .013"); J-6880 rocker stud installer; J-5802 rocker stud remover.
J-9534 and J-9535 distributor lower bushing remover and installer; J-22144 and J-8369 oil pick-up screen installers; J-6098 cam bearing tool; J-0971 camshaft gear support.

J-6978 torsional damper puller; J-22197 torsional damper installer; J-21058 damper and sprocket installer; J-1619 and J-5825 crankshaft sprocket pullers; J-8105 crankshaft gear puller; J-5590 crankshaft sprocket or gear installer.
J-0966 and J-21742 crankcase cover centering gauges; J-22102 crankcase cover tool; J-8340 and J-996 crankcase cover seal installers.
